author: dandyv2014

title: Good starting point for our trip
text: Rey was really knowledgeable and a great guide. The tapas was okay but we’ve found better since on our own. We did it on our first night, so it was a good way of finding our way around. If you want a starting point this is good. We asked Rey about other tours they do and have booked the White Villages and Ronda day trip. We’ve been into Triana again which we may not have ventured to had we not been on this tour.
author: 754eveyp

title: Authentic Triana with Álvaro! 🇪🇸🍻
text:
I had a great time with Álvaro. He took us to two places to eat tapas and we were able to try several local specialties, among them fried fish and spinach with chickpeas.

We also walked the streets of Triana and visited the Isabel II Bridge. Álvaro told us many things about the history of Seville and the neighborhood. You can tell that he is a person very passionate about what he does, very attentive, available, and always willing to answer questions.

In general, it was a very good experience and a pleasant surprise, especially because of that authentic and cultural side.

text: We had a great tapas tour in Triana with Rebecca. We tried different foods that we would never have tried otherwise. She was very knowledgeable about the area and the history of Seville which made it a really interesting couple of hours.
author: O2997BIlucieh

title: Considerate tour guide
text: I highly recommend this tour. We tasted a variety of excellent tapas in Triana. The guide helped me find a taxi, very considerate. It was a holiday, and no taxis were available. It was after midnight so I did not want to walk as a solo traveler. She also worked very hard to integrate everyone into the group.
